items.title: HelloGitHub Badge
items.reason: Canonical precedent: another external service requested its promotional badge in uv's README, and a maintainer declined.

items.title: Update badge logo SVG
items.reason: Adjacent but distinct: it concerns uv's own badge asset for downstream READMEs, not a third-party score in uv's README.

items.reason: The implementation paired with astral-sh/uv#15076 confirms that discussion is limited to the project-owned uv badge's logo.

related.search_scope: Exact searches covered “Agent Friendly,” agentfriendlycode.com, “score badge,” and “agent friendliness”; conceptual searches covered badge, README badge, external badge, code-quality badge, AI friendliness, and shields.io; implementation-oriented searches covered badge-related pull requests in open, closed, and merged states. The strongest candidates and their comment/reference chains were inspected. No provider-specific predecessor or merged implementation was found. astral-sh/uv#13061 was ruled out as an off-topic CI-badge comment extracted from unrelated astral-sh/uv#13051, and astral-sh/uv#18304 was ruled out because it proposes AI chat in the documentation.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#7883 covers the same underlying repository request: an external service asking uv to display its badge in the project README. A maintainer declined that request. The provider and advertised metric differ, but the requested change and policy decision are the same, so duplicate takes precedence over enhancement.
summary: The request most closely duplicates the declined external-service badge proposal in astral-sh/uv#7883. astral-sh/uv#15076 and astral-sh/uv#15075 are related only as a contrasting discussion of uv's own downstream badge asset.
draft_response: Thanks for sharing this. We previously declined the same kind of request to add an external service's badge to uv's README in astral-sh/uv#7883. We'll keep the README unchanged here and close this as a duplicate of astral-sh/uv#7883.
